title: My neighbor mows at 3:33 a.m.
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, suburban American home at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: My neighbor mows his lawn at 3:33 a.m. Tonight he stopped.

shots.prompt: mowed lawn at night, a lawnmower left in the middle of a dark suburban back yard, a half-cut stripe of grass, no person visible

scenes.narration: Every night. Same slow lines. I never saw his face. Only heard the engine through my window. I called it background noise. My dog never barked at it. Not once. Tonight, he hid under the bed.

shots.prompt: dark suburban bedroom window with curtains, faint streetlight glow

scenes.narration: Tonight it stopped halfway. The silence woke me. I went to the window. He stood on his half-cut grass. Facing my house. Not moving. Just a dark shape, and the smell of cut grass drifting through my window.

shots.prompt: dark back yard at night, a tall silhouette far away in the grass, back turned, no face

scenes.narration: My phone buzzed. A text from my own number. Close the curtain. Slowly. Don't look at him. Whatever you do, don't let him see you move.

shots.prompt: smartphone glowing in the dark on a bed, blue light

scenes.narration: I did. The engine started again. Louder. Closer. Right under my window. Mowing my lawn. I don't own a mower. And the cut grass smell filled my whole room.

shots.prompt: curtain glowing faintly with a shadow behind it in a dark bedroom, no face

scenes.narration: Then I understood. He never watched my window. He mowed to cover the sound. Of something else. Standing behind my bed. Breathing along with me. Waiting for me to notice.

shots.prompt: dark empty bedroom, a bed from behind, a doorway in shadow, no person visible

scenes.narration: So tell me. Turn around, or keep staring at the curtain?

shots.prompt: mowed lawn at night, a lawnmower left in the middle of a dark suburban back yard, a half-cut stripe of grass, no person visible
